nom: NEOGEN Dermalogy Day Light Protection Airy Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 50

avis.texte: I've been using this for a few weeks now. It is very lightweight, works well with my moisterizer and sets quickly, doesn't seem to change anything with the wear of my makeup and on top of that it does not burn my eyes!!! I have even rubbed my eyes after applying it just to be sure, I had a slight stinging one time, but I had really rubbed it in that day for the final test. I can't stand my eyes stinging from sunscreen. I wore it when we went kayaking for the day (under makeup) and even with sweating and some water being splashed, never had any eye irritation

I'm so happy to see this at Ulta! I've been using this sunscreen for years - previously buying direct from Korean skincare websites. Recently I went to repurchase this and I couldn't find it… I was so worried that they had discontinued it. I've tried lots of popular K-beauty and J-beauty brand sunscreens, but this one is my favorite because it doesn't feel or smell like a "typical" sunscreen. It's very lightweight, sits well under makeup, doesn't leave your skin looking greasy, and is just generally pleasant to use. This is a holy grail product for me that I highly recommend!

True to its name, this sunscreen goes on incredibly smooth and leaves absolutely no white cast. The texture is lightweight and absorbs fully, making it feel like you aren't wearing anything at all. Love that it offers high SPF protection without the heavy feel! It's gifted by Neogen

This sunscreen is great for combo skin. It absorbs so easily and doesn't feel greasy on the skin, this is particularly amazing for summer given my skin needs lightweight, non greasy formulas otherwise I'll be a glazed donut by the end of the day. This product was gifted by Neogen.

I'm super picky with sunscreen because most feel heavy or make my skin greasy, but this one surprised me. It feels so light and breathable, almost like skincare instead of SPF. No white cast at all, and my skin stays soft, hydrated, and balanced throughout the day. I also love that it works well under makeup and doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. gifted by neogen

complimentary from Neogen I've been using the Day-Light Protection Airy Sunscreen and I'm honestly really impressed. The texture is super light, almost like nothing on the skin, and it sinks in fast without leaving any white cast or greasy feeling. It sits perfectly under makeup and doesn't pill, which is a big win for me. My skin feels protected but still breathable, like I actually want to wear it every day. It gives that soft healthy finish without looking shiny or heavy. Overall, it feels like a very easy, elegant everyday SPF that just does its job really well.

gifted by neogen complimentary from neogen I have tried so many sunscreen but this one is amazing. It doesn't leave white cast which I absolutely hate and other than that it gives me a perfect skin kiss glow that I am obsessed with. Highly recommended

This sunscreen feels lightweight and comfortable on the skin without leaving a heavy or greasy finish. It layers well under makeup and gives a natural glow throughout the day. Overall, it's a nice everyday sunscreen option that wears comfortably throughout the day. gifted by neogen

As someone with dry skin, I really appreciate this sunscreen. It has a moisturizing texture, so I can use it directly without needing to apply an additional moisturizer. I also like that it doesn't leave a white cast or have a strong scent. Overall, it's a gentle, hydrating sunscreen that does its job well. Complimentary from Neogen.

This was gifted by neogen for my honest review. This is a pleasantly light smelling cream that helps protect your face from the harms of the sun. I do not recommend getting it too close to your lips just in case you happen to lick them. The taste of it is nasty. But it does help keep you from burning when outdoors. Overall I give it an A!

As an oily girl, I appreciate this sunscreen so much. It leaves my skin protected without any greasy feeling or flashback. I've started using it as my daily moisturizer and I can't wait to see how it transforms my skin over time! Gifted by Neogen.
Lightweight and super comfortable on my skin. It absorbs fast, doesn't feel greasy, and works great under makeup. My face stayed hydrated and protected all day without irritation.

gifted by Neogen. This airy sunscreen is just that lightweight and airy. It's not a thick consistency. It absorbs quickly leaves no white cast. It has a very faint sunscreen scent to it. I didn't experience any stinging in my eyes when sweating.

I really like this sunscreen. It doesn't leave a white cast and blends out easily and effortlessly. This also has a lightweight texture, so it doesn't feel heavy on the skin or leave a greasy feel. I also appreciate that this has ingredients in it to help with oils because I have really oily skin. This sunscreen also makes my skin look really smooth after applying and wears well under makeup. Gifted by Neogen

This sunscreen delivers on all the important things: truly no white cast and feels really light on the skin. Love that it's SPF 50 since I don't always get a chance to reapply throughout the day, so having that higher protection upfront is something I look for. The bottle is on the smaller side but feels reasonable for the price point. gifted by neogen

DAY LIGHT PROTECTION AIRY SUN SCREEN has amazing moisturizing ingredients. I put it on my skin before my make up routine everyday. It does not give any white cast, feels non-oily and has a milky light texture. This sunscreen absorbs fast and feel like nothing is on my skin. gifted by Neogen

gifted by Neogen I received this complimentary sunscreen to test and review. It has a lightweight and airy texture that is fast absorbing and very hydrating. It is formulated with broad spectrum SPF 50 for optimal sun protection and hydration. It is so soothing and reduces sebum with the help of 20 different natural plant extracts. It blends beautifully into my skin without any stickiness or white cast and protects my delicate skin from harmful UV rays. It's so hydrating I don't even need a separate moisturizer!

I was gifted by neogen this sunscreen. It is really moisturizing and I love the packaging. It rubs in very well. I have never heard of the brand, but it seems like a great brand. Thanks for letting me try it out!

This is a really nice, light SPF. It absorbs well into my skin and left my face feeling moisturized and protected. I love the size as well so I can throw it in my purse and apply through the day. complimentary from neogen

I really like this sunscreen. It's super light weight so it doesn't feel heavy or sticky on my face. It also blends in super well and doesn't leave any sort of white cast on your face. Gifted by neogen

Gifted by neogen I love how lightweight and hydrating this sunscreen is. It blends in effortlessly with no white cast and leaves my skin smooth, fresh, and less oily throughout the day. It feels so moisturizing that I can use it instead of my regular moisturizer.

gifted by Neogen For an honest review! This may be my new favorite sunscreen! It gives no white cast at all, and absorbs into the skin quickly! I love how hydrating it is, I've been using it in place of a moisturizer! Would 100% recommend this spf!

This sunscreen was gifted to me by Neogen. I am an active person and the summer heat is out. At all cost I need to protect my skin. I have dark skin and no white cast is a plus when it comes to sunscreen. Neogen sunscreen leaves me looking well moisturized and protected from the sun on my morning runs or where ever I go and the sun is out.

gifted by neogen. I have been enjoying this sunscreen so much! I am very active outdoors and live in a sunny year-round climate and appreciate how lightweight and hydrating this sunscreen is. I don't have to use a separate moisturizer in my AM routine if I use this. It is also a great base for makeup! It does not leave a white cast and can also be reapplied right on top of my makeup. It doesn't break me out or feel greasy. Such a great addition to my summer skincare routine!

avis.titre: So hydrating and no white cast
avis.texte: The application is flawless. This sunscreen is so good and has no white cast. I love how it doesn't even look like you applied sunscreen because of how nicely it blends into the skin. The sunscreen is a little thick but very lightweight and hydrating and absorbs very nicely into the skin. I would definitely recommend this for people who have oily skin. Works great. Gifted by neogen.

This sunscreen feels really lightweight on the skin and doesn't leave a white cast. It gives a smooth finish without feeling greasy, and I like that it keeps my skin hydrated while still helping with oil control. It layers well under makeup and feels comfortable for everyday wear. Gifted by neogen

I love this sunscreen from Neogen! It's so light and airy. I love that it has SPF 50 so I feel protected. It leaves my skin feeling moisturized. The best part is that there is no white cast. I will be reaching for this all summer long. A must have for spring/summer. gifted by Neogen

This sunscreen is perfect for every day. It does not leave a white cast, feels lightweight and hydrating, and keeps my skin looking healthy without feeling greasy at all. It works really well with foundation as well. Gifted by Neogen.

This sunscreen feels super lightweight on the skin and absorbs quickly without feeling greasy or heavy. It's actually pretty moisturizing too, so my skin stays soft throughout the day. The best part is that it doesn't leave a white cast!! Gifted by Neogen.

its gifted by neogen. It's lightweight and breathable formula. Skin feeling comfortable all day. It's good works beautifully under makeup. No balls. It has good function for hydration. It's nice option as daily sun product.

This sunscreen is so smooth, I love using this one because if the fact it leaves absolutely no white cast on my skin! It's smooth, blends in so easily, and also has great ingredients for your skin so you're protected from the skin! gifted by neogen

I really like this sunscreen. It absorbs and rubs into the skin nicely and doesn't leave a white cast. My skin is sensitive and breaks out easily and didn't with this product. I received this product complimentary from neogen in exchange for my honest feedback.

This sunscreen surprised me in the best way. Super lightweight, blends in fast with zero white cast, and doesn't leave my skin greasy at all. My makeup sits really nice over it too and it feels so comfortable all day. gifted by neogen.

As someone who wears makeup almost every day, finding a sunscreen that feels lightweight and layers beautifully underneath everything is so important to me and NEOGEN Day-Light Protection Airy Sunscreen has honestly been such a good find. The texture is super airy and comfortable, almost like a lightweight moisturizer, and it gives my skin the prettiest healthy glow without feeling greasy. I also love how it keeps my skin feeling hydrated throughout the day while still sitting perfectly under foundation. No white cast, no heaviness, no pilling : just fresh, smooth skin that feels protected and comfortable all day long. It's quickly become one of those everyday products I automatically reach for in my morning routine. ✨ complimentary from neogen

I received the NEOGEN Dermalogy Day-Light Protection Airy Sunscreen SPF 50 complimentary from Neogen in exchange for an honest review. The texture is super lightweight and airy, so it doesn't feel heavy or greasy on the skin at all. One of my favorite things is that it leaves absolutely no white cast, even after reapplying. It blends in so smoothly and gives my skin a healthy, natural finish. After using it consistently, my skin feels smoother, hydrated, and noticeably less oily throughout the day. It gives enough moisture that I honestly skip moisturizer most mornings and just use this instead. My makeup also sits really nicely on top without pilling. Overall, it's such a comfortable everyday sunscreen that feels more like skincare than SPF

complimentary from neogen - I like the serum like formula of this spf, but something in it is irritating to my skin. I'm not sure if it's the fragrance, but I even get irritated skin on my hands when I patch tested it there. Unfortunately won't really be able to use it on my face since I don't want a more severe reaction. The finish looks nice though

Love this sunscreen! No white cast at all and the texture feels super lightweight. My skin looks smoother, hydrated, and less oily all day. It's so hydrating that I can skip moisturizer when I'm traveling or pressed for time. Also, can confirm- applies well with makeup. gifted by neogen

This sunscreen feels so lightweight and comfortable on the skin. It applies and absorbs just like a light lotion with no greasy or oily residue left behind. I also love that it leaves no white cast. Reapplication is easy throughout the day, and it works really well as a morning moisturizer too. It also gives great sun protection with SPF 50! Gifted by Neogen.

Gifted by Neogen. I really like this sunscreen, it's lightweight, yet very hydrating. I don't need to use a separate moisturizer. It absorbs fast. It leaves a nice matte finish with no white cast and it's not no greasy or heavy feeling. Oh and it smells really nice, citrusy.

avis.titre: Lightweight & comfortable for all day wear
avis.texte: This is truly the first sunscreen that I can say it does not bother me at at all! It doesn't feel heavy and greasy on my skin, no white cast and it actually feel lightweight, breathable and comfortable even for all day wear! I love it! complimentary from neogen

This product was complimentary from neogen in return for a honest review. This sunscreen product is super light weight But still moisturizing! It also has a very nice smell to it! When putting on and after rubbing in there is ZERO white cast! 10/10

Gifted by Neogen. The Day-Light Protection Airy Sunscreen is what I need this summer. The sunscreen is lightweight and not sticky or greasy. There is no white cast and no residue. It feels really comfortable on my face. It even feels moisturizing and hydrating! My family and I tend to apply a generous amount of sunscreen each application and then we re-apply quite frequently, especially if we go into the water. I wish this sunscreen were a little larger because it will not last long with us.

I'm really impressed with this sunscreen! It feels super lightweight on the skin and blends in effortlessly without leaving any white cast. The added hyaluronic acid keeps my skin hydrated all day, giving it a nice healthy glow instead of that typical greasy finish. It wears beautifully under makeup and doesn't irritate my sensitive skin at all. Definitely a new staple in my daily routine! gifted by neogen

avis.titre: A great daily SPF, light and moisturizing
avis.texte: This Day Light Protection Airy Sun Screen by Neogen is super lightweight and you barely feel like you're wearing a sun screen. It is very moisturizing and leaves no white caste. It absorbs very quickly into the skin and is not greasy at all. I am very happy to use this in place of a daily moisturizer as it hydrates as well as giving me SPF 50 which is super important for me. I love the scent of the product, it's slightly herby which feels fresh and light. This really leaves no stickiness on the skin and it felt quite matte once it had completely absorbed. I really like this sunscreen. I received this product for free and exchange for my honest opinion. complimentary from neogen

This is my new favorite sunscreen!! It's light, airy, and absorbs super fast! I usually struggle with applying sunscreen and then my face is super oily and applying makeup over top is a nightmare. I love that I'm able to apply this and put makeup on soon after since it absorbs quick and isn't greasy! Amazing!! complimentary from neogen

I received this Day-Light Protection Airy Sunscreen complimentary from Neogen abd I'm so glad I did. This has no weird smell. Glides on like butter. Packaging is pleasing. Blocks out UV rays that I know Ill be safe from sunburn and cancer. Great product.

I loveeee this super lightweight sunscreen! It is truly light as air while of course offering Sun protection. I feel like my skin has a bit more of a glow than normal rather than a matte look but perhaps that's just my skin. complimentary from neogen

This is a great daily sunscreen that feels hydrating and nourishing on the skin. It's lightweight and nongreasy, perfect for those with oily skin. It doesn't leave a white cast either. Most sunscreens cause skin irritation, but this one doesn't. Gifted by neogen

I'm extremely picky with sunscreen because my skin is dry and sensitive, but this one surprised me in the best way. The texture feels so lightweight and airy on the skin — no greasy finish, no heavy feeling, and absolutely no white cast on my complexion. It layers beautifully under makeup and gives my skin a healthy, hydrated glow without looking oily. I also love that it's SPF 50 while still feeling comfortable enough for everyday wear. It honestly feels more like a skincare product than a traditional sunscreen. Perfect for Florida weather and daily use. Highly recommend if you want protection without sacrificing how your skin looks and feels! gifted by neogen complimentary from neogen

This is a great lightweight sunscreen. It's just what the name says. It's light and airy. I like that it blends in easily. It's not thick and heavy. It's lightweight and is easy to use. It has spf 50 too. gifted by neogen

It goes on super airy and quickly absorbs. It as well leaving my skin feeling soft and doesn't leave a white cast or greasy finish. I've been wearing it under makeup and it layers really nicely without pilling. Definitely one I keep reaching for this daily as has become apart of my daily skin routine. gifted by neogen

I've been using this sunscreen regularly for a few days now (received complimentary from NEOGEN), and I have been absolutely loving it. My mom has oily skin and mentioned she noticed it helped keep excess oil in check. I have skin on the normal side, and we both thought our skin looked balanced and fresh throughout the day!

Hydrating and works well with SPF 50. The formula feels lightweight and provides good protection. Perfect combo for sun protection and hydration. There is also no white cast which makes it perfect for everyday use. gifted by neogen.

I've been using this as my daily sunscreen and love how it fits into my routine without any effort. My skin feels soft and hydrated after applying and most days I actually use this in place of a moisturizer because it gives me enough hydration on its own. complimentary from neogen

This sunscreen is such a game changer! ☀️ The SPF 50 gives strong protection without feeling heavy, and it actually feels like skincare. Perfect for daily wear, even under makeup. gifted by neogen

Complimentary from Neogen, this airy SPF 50 sunscreen has me genuinely obsessed. Lightweight, breathable, and very comfortable on the skin. It blends in effortlessly without leaving a white cast and gives a soft, natural finish that works beautifully under makeup. Overall, a great daily sunscreen option. gifted by Neogen

gifted by neogen. This is such an amazing lightweight sunscreen. I love that it is 50 SPF. It has little to no scent to it. And there was no white cast which is a must for me! I'll definitely be repurchasing this sunscreen!

I really enjoy using this sunscreen. It is very lightweight and non greasy. Does not leave a thick feeling layer or pill. I would say this does leave a slightly shiny finish but it isn't too noticeable. This is my go to sunscreen for hiking and outdoors. gifted by neogen

The DAY LIGHT PROTECTION AIRY SUN SCREEN complimentary from neogen works super well and has no white hue. Easy to blend in and lots of protection. Can't wait to use this product all summer and see how it works!

The DAY LIGHT PROTECTION AIRY SUN SCREEN complimentary from neogen is perfect for summer. Easy to apply and just a little goes a long way. Excellent value for the price which is a huge plus. I would definitely recommend and repurchase.

I like how easy this is to apply, it glides on and disappears into my skin with no white cast. It leaves my face feeling soft and lightly hydrated. Gifted by neogen. This spf crème is fantastic! It is super lightweight and gives me sun protection without leaving a white cast. I highly recommend this if you're looking for a new spf moisturizer that is lightweight.
